connector.name: Semantic Search
connector.registryDescription: Semantic search for Historical Soundscapes. Search eventos, entities, filters. Cross-lingual ES/EN.
connector.summary: Hosted at historicalsoundscapes.com over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.historicalsoundscapes.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
